items.headline: Hedera mainnet v0.76.3 upgrade completed and network available
items.summary: Hedera's official status page states the scheduled mainnet v0.76 upgrade began at 02:00 UTC and the network was available again by 02:16 UTC while verification continued. No material exploit or unscheduled network-wide outage was identified in this run.
items.whyItMatters: Scheduled mainnet upgrades can temporarily affect network availability and operational risk, but this event completed without evidence of a material security incident.
items.actionReason: Resolved scheduled maintenance only; it does not create a Crypto Reca entry or exit signal.

items.headline: U.S. spot ether ETFs record $102.1M net inflows on Aug. 28
items.summary: Farside Investors' current table shows $102.1M of net inflows into U.S. spot ether ETFs on Aug. 28, led by ETHA +$83.8M and ETHB +$42.6M, partly offset by FETH -$24.3M.
items.whyItMatters: A fourth consecutive strong positive session extends the regulated-product demand signal for ETH despite the broader hawkish macro backdrop.
items.actionReason: Positive ETF flows are contextual only and never create a Crypto Reca buy signal. The latest available Crypto Reca Radar is stale and does not independently confirm this development.

items.headline: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs close Aug. 28 with $201.9M net outflows
items.summary: Farside's direct table now shows a reconciled Aug. 28 total of -$201.9M, including IBIT -$33.4M, BITB -$49.7M, ARKB -$114.9M, HODL -$13.2M and MSBT +$9.3M. This resolves the prior incomplete-primary-table status.
items.whyItMatters: The negative session breaks the prior nine-session inflow streak and is a material short-term regulated-flow deterioration.
items.actionReason: Material negative flow context does not override Crypto Reca hard gates and does not independently create a sale, reduce or new-entry instruction.

items.headline: U.S. spot Solana ETFs record $17.3M net inflows on Aug. 28
items.summary: Farside Investors' current table shows $17.3M of net inflows into U.S. spot Solana ETFs on Aug. 28, following a materially stronger prior session.
items.whyItMatters: The positive regulated-product flow continues, but at a materially slower pace than the prior session.
items.actionReason: Constructive context only; positive news never creates a Crypto Reca buy signal.

items.headline: U.S. spot Solana ETFs record strong Aug. 27 net inflows
items.summary: Fresh reporting citing ETF flow data showed a material positive Aug. 27 session, correcting the prior provisional zero figure stored by this module.
items.whyItMatters: The corrected flow is a material regulated-product demand signal for SOL and removes the prior apparent pause in inflows.
items.actionReason: Positive ETF flows are contextual only and never create a Crypto Reca buy signal.

items.headline: U.S. spot ether ETFs record $225.8M net inflows on Aug. 27
items.summary: Farside Investors' current table shows $225.8M of net inflows into U.S. spot ether ETFs on Aug. 27, following $192.4M on Aug. 26 and $179.8M on Aug. 25.
items.whyItMatters: Three consecutive large positive sessions strengthen regulated-product demand context for ETH.
items.actionReason: Positive ETF flows are contextual only and never create a Crypto Reca buy signal.

items.headline: Solana validators narrowly pass faster-disinflation proposal SGP-0002; SGP-0003 fails
items.summary: CoinDesk reports SGP-0002 finished with about 67% support, barely above the two-thirds threshold; SGP-0003 failed with about 54% support.
items.whyItMatters: The governance mandate supports faster reductions in future SOL issuance if implemented.
items.actionReason: Material fundamental resolution, not a Crypto Reca entry trigger.

items.headline: Warsh speech pushes next-Fed-meeting rate-hike expectations above 50%
items.summary: Reuters reports Fed Chair Kevin Warsh signaled further action may be needed if inflation progress stalls; short-term Treasury yields and the dollar rose and rate-hike pricing moved above 50% from about 35%.
items.whyItMatters: Tighter Fed expectations can pressure crypto risk appetite.
items.actionReason: Post-event macro context only; no trade instruction.

items.headline: Final U.S. spot bitcoin ETF data show $242.3M net inflows on Aug. 27
items.summary: Farside shows $242.3M net inflows on Aug. 27, extending the positive streak to nine sessions.
items.whyItMatters: Sustained regulated-product inflows strengthen institutional-demand context.
items.actionReason: Positive ETF demand cannot create a Crypto Reca entry.

items.headline: Bitcoin treasury-company model unwinds as top holders turn net sellers
items.summary: Financial Times analysis found the 50 largest bitcoin-treasury companies shifted to net selling in July.
items.whyItMatters: A shift toward net selling can remove demand and create supply overhang.

items.headline: Charles Schwab plans to add Solana and Avalanche trading in coming months
items.summary: CoinDesk reports Charles Schwab plans to add SOL and AVAX trading to Schwab Crypto in the coming months.
items.whyItMatters: Broader brokerage access can improve accessibility for SOL and AVAX.

catalysts.headline: U.S. Employment Situation for August 2026
catalysts.summary: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics schedules the August 2026 Employment Situation report for Sept. 4 at 8:30 a.m. ET (14:30 Madrid).
catalysts.whyItMatters: Payrolls, unemployment and wage data can materially reprice Fed expectations, yields and the dollar.
catalysts.actionReason: More than 24 hours away; no escalation yet.
